newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia couple jailed in "tit-for-tat" rape case.
newsitem.headline: Colombia couple jailed in "tit-for-tat" rape case.

text.p: A couple was arrested in Colombia's Caribbean port of Barranquilla on charges of raping a teenage boy they accuse of molesting their son, local media reports said on Wednesday.

El Tiempo newspaper said Roberto Terri Muvdi and his wife Luz Karime, both well known in Barranquilla social circles, had been detained since Friday when witnesses caught them in the act of raping the 15-year-old boy with a stick on a beach outside Barranquilla.
A spokesman for the local prosecutor's office told Reuters the couple assaulted the teenager, whose father is a Navy captain, in reprisal for what they insist was his rape of their 7-year-old son.
Their lawyer, Guido Mazzenet, told El Tiempo the Muvdis could not rightly be accused of rape because "they weren't seeking to satisfy their sexual appetite."
"This was an eminently correctional act and a punishment carried out to satisfy a thirst for justice," he said.
